description: Search the registry's OSINT tools by words, the input type they take, the entity type they find, or category. passive_only keeps the tools ot runs without asking the person.

category.description: only this category, such as domain-dns or social-media

input_type.description: only tools that take this input type (email, username, domain, ip, url, phone, ...); list_types lists them

no_keys.description: only tools that need no API key

output_type.description: only tools that find this entity type

passive_only.description: only tools that run offline, touch no target and collect no personal data

query.description: words to search for in names, summaries and tags

name: search_tools
title: Search tools
